papers.headline: International Astrophysical Consortium for High-energy Calibration: Summary of the 18th IACHEC Workshop
papers.summary: In this report we summarize the activities of the International Astronomical Consortium for High Energy Calibration (IACHEC) from the 18th IACHEC Workshop at Pelham, Germany.
papers.title: International Astrophysical Consortium for High-energy Calibration: Summary of the 18th IACHEC Workshop

papers.headline: GRB 181201A: Spectropolarimetric Constraints on Prompt Emission and Magnetic Field Structure
papers.summary: Gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) have served as testbeds for high-energy astrophysical phenomena since their discovery over 50 years ago.
papers.title: GRB 181201A: Spectropolarimetric Constraints on Prompt Emission and Magnetic Field Structure

papers.headline: Binary-lens amplification of starlight: from magnification flares to quasi-periodic tracking of orbital evolution
papers.summary: Supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHB) are expected at the center of galaxies as a result of galaxy mergers.
papers.title: Binary-lens amplification of starlight: from magnification flares to quasi-periodic tracking of orbital evolution
papers.authors: H. Wang, B. Kocsis, M. Zumalacárregui
